versions.subject: add image_load_susp_advapi32_dll
versions.detection:
selection:
  ImageLoaded|endswith: '\advapi32.dll'
filter_commun:
  Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
filter_defender:
  Image|startswith: 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\platform\'
  Image|endswith: '\MpCmdRun.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\advapi32.dll" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Windows\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\*") OR (Image="C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\platform\\*" Image="*\\MpCmdRun.exe"))
